o: In the second season, our lovers are separated once again as the Scottish Highlands are split in two by the 1715 Jacobite Rising, thrusting the clans into war and forcing them to choose a side in the rebellion.

eps.o: The fiery crosses have been lit across the Highlands. The call to arms brings friends and enemies home and the Jacobite Rebellion begins in earnest.
Brian and Ellen help their clans prepare for the rebellion. Julia and Henry learn more about the stones at Craigh na Dun from unexpected sources.
Julia welcomes a new member of staff to Leathers. Brian and Dougal train their men for battle. Ellen uses her wit to defend her family and her clan.
Ellen and Grace ride across the Highlands in search of Brian and Dougal's forces.
The Jacobite Army fights at the Battle of Sheriffmuir, while Ellen and Julia face their own dangers. Colum holds fast at Leoch but doubts his resolve.
Ellen finds herself a guest among unexpected company. Brian and Murtagh attempt a daring rescue. Henry makes an ally of a former enemy.
Henry ventures off to procure gemstones. Julia finds a way to get back in Lovat's good graces. Brian returns to Leathers to settle a score.
Julia and Lovat attend an event honoring Loyalist Lairds who fought against the Jacobites. Ellen's plan to protect Leoch is put to the test.

Colum experiences a tragedy, and Maura uses the opportunity to encourage Dougal to lead. Murtagh defends Grace from harm, with terrible ramifications for their relationship. Henry watches as a new and dangerous romance unfolds.
